name: m4-uniques-paired-aa

variantDescriptions.weak-aa: the same options as `weak`: an A/A, the noise floor of a paired delta
variantDescriptions.chunked: `ChunkedInterner(weak = false)`, types held until the run ends
variantDescriptions.uncache-all: chunked-weak, and new types made in any weak scope are not interned (4096-slot direct-mapped cache)

description: Follow-up to [m4-uniques-paired](#c-m4-uniques-paired) (job 551), where chunked came out −0.4% and uncache-all −0.7% (one fork +0.2%, two −1.0% and −1.3%) against weak, and chunked-weak +0.15%. Adds an A/A pair (`weak-aa`) for the noise floor and doubles the forks; drops chunked-weak, which was flat. Same build and setup.
